source.label: 2025 Current Population Survey Annual Social and Economic Supplement

method.taxUnits: Census TAX_ID; reference-person MARSUPWT; joint schedule from FILESTAT 1-3
method.adultCreditUnits: All persons age 18+ assigned to the Census tax unit; calibrated to the 2025 Census adult population
method.children: All persons under 18 assigned to the Census tax unit; calibrated to the 2025 Census child population
method.compensation: ASEC WSAL_VAL distribution raked to BEA wages; employer social-insurance and pension/insurance supplements allocated in proportion to cash wages
method.scope: Static tax-unit distribution; no behavior, take-up response, or top-tail administrative match beyond BEA aggregate raking

uncertainty.method: Census ASEC 160 replicate weights; variance = (4/160) × sum((replicate − full sample)^2)
